data.name: Almost Retired
data.detailed_description:
You are a miner, and you are almost done.

Forty years in the belt. One cell of charge per shift, a tractor beam, and three tools that each know one job. Cut a meteor open, take what's inside, sell it to people who need it. Put what's left into the fund.

When the fund is full, you retire. To a planet you have only seen in a brochure, where someone is waiting who was a child last time you visited.

That's the whole game. Nothing chases you. Nothing runs out. The belt will still be here tomorrow.

The right tool for the layer

Every meteor is built in layers: a dull crust, something better underneath, and sometimes a core worth the whole shift.

  • SHOCK strips the shell fast, and wastes ore doing it.
  • LASER is the workhorse that can do anything, slowly.
  • ION draws a clean line and splits the rock open without losing a gram.

Any tool cuts anything. The right one just does it better.

A shift at a time

Scan the field. Pick your rock. Work it down layer by layer while the sun drops behind the belt.

Dock. Sell to the orders on the board. Spend on the pod or the station. Decide how much goes into the fund this time.

Then do it again, for as long as you like.

The people on the board

Orders come from people. A foreman whose crew broke the thing that makes the other things. A widow keeping her husband's ship running. A robot with no reasons, only wants.

Between belts you'll meet stranger things: a buoy selling equipment that does not work in zero gravity, a broadcast about who really owns the rocks, a memorial nobody maintains, a man in a too-tight shirt explaining why saving for retirement is a waste of your time.

The fund

Deposits are one-way. The bar fills slowly, then all at once, and one day the station tells you that you are done.

Or you leave early. That's allowed too. The game never punishes you for it, but it will remember.

What's in it

  • Real layered destruction, cut with actual geometry
  • Three tools with three jobs, and drones that learn to help
  • Sixteen encounters, most of which want something from you
  • A cockpit that fills up with things you kept
  • Two endings, both of them yours
  • No death, no fail states, no timer on anything
  • Built for Steam Deck first

data.short_description: A cozy zero-gravity mining sim. Cut layered meteors with three tools, fill your retirement fund, and make it to paradise, one quiet shift at a time. No death, no timers, no pressure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB VRAM (Intel UHD 620 / GTX 750 Ti class)
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better, 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended
